mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals an overheated labor market that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a falling unemployment rate signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE is falling (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand economic regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2% YoY), a rising housing starts index (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% YoY and HOUST rising
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 2% YoY and HOUST is rising (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is rising (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index rises above 3.0% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is rising and industrial production (INDPRO) is falling, it indicates a demand-supply imbalance that fuels inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 is rising and INDPRO is falling (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS is rising (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
